editorial_note: Learner-facing Bengali uses তুমি/করো. English of/and word-position cues are rendered as functional Bengali dividend/divisor labels because literal postpositions cannot follow the original numeric elements without changing preserved MathML punctuation/order. Introductory glosses explicitly distinguish ভাজ্য and ভাজক. This is a language adaptation, not a rule that English of always means division; the exact source subsection has no multiplication-of lesson. Difference order is first minus second, and the entire sum or difference is divided by the stated nonzero divisor. Terminology and the adapted phrasing remain provisional pending independent Indian Bengali/West Bengal review. There are no source images or tables in this section.
